English.summary_markdown:
# 🌟 English — Week 2: Sounding Out Words!

Let's learn to read new words by **sounding them out**! 🔤

## 🔠 Sight Words
- **Sight words** are common words we should recognize instantly: *the, is, and, can, see*
- Practicing sight words helps us read **faster and smoother**.

## 🧩 CVC Words (Consonant-Vowel-Consonant)
- CVC words have 3 letters: a **consonant**, then a **vowel**, then a **consonant**.
- **Example 1:** *mat* = /m/ + /a/ + /t/
- **Example 2:** *sit* = /s/ + /i/ + /t/

## 🎯 How to Sound Out a Word
1. Say the **first sound**.
2. Say the **middle sound**.
3. Say the **last sound**.
4. **Blend** them together to say the whole word!

Practice sounding out words every day — you'll become a super reader! 🌟

Mathematics.summary_markdown:
# 🔷 Mathematics — Week 2: More Circles and Composite Figures!

Let's practice building bigger shapes from smaller ones! 🧩

## ⭕ Review: Circles and Parts of Circles
- A whole **circle** can be split into **2 half circles** or **4 quarter circles**.
- We can put half circles and quarter circles **back together** to make a whole circle again!

## 🧩 Building Composite Figures
- **Composite figures** combine squares, rectangles, triangles, circles, half circles, and quarter circles.
- **Example 1:** A rectangle body + a triangle roof = a **house**!
- **Example 2:** A circle + two quarter circles = looks like a **flower petal pattern**!

## 🔍 Decomposing Figures
- We can also **break apart** a big figure into the smaller shapes that made it.
- **Example:** A house shape breaks into 1 rectangle + 1 triangle.

Keep practicing — you're becoming a shape expert! 🌟

Filipino.summary_markdown:
# 🇵🇭 Filipino — Linggo 2: Palabigkasan at Pagkilala ng Salita

Matuto tayong magbasa ng mga bagong salita! 📖

## 🔤 Mga Salitang Paningin (Sight Words)
- Ang **salitang paningin** ay karaniwang salitang dapat nating makilala kaagad: *ako, ikaw, siya, ang, sa, at*

## 🧩 Mga Salitang CVC
- Ang mga salitang CVC ay binubuo ng **katinig-patinig-katinig**.
- **Halimbawa 1:** *bata* — sa, ta
- **Halimbawa 2:** *aso* — a, so

## 🎯 Paano Bumigkas ng Salita
1. Bigkasin ang **unang tunog**.
2. Bigkasin ang **gitnang tunog**.
3. Bigkasin ang **huling tunog**.
4. **Pagsamahin** ang lahat ng tunog para bumuo ng buong salita!

Pagsanayan natin ito araw-araw upang maging mahusay na mambabasa! 🌟

Science.summary_markdown:
# 🔬 Science — Week 2: Sorting Living and Nonliving Things

Let's practice sorting things around us! 🔍

## 🏡 Living and Nonliving in Our Environment
- We can find living and nonliving things at **home**, **school**, and in the **yard**.
- **Example:** A plant in the garden is **living**; a garden fence is **nonliving**.

## 🍂 Once-Living Materials
- Some materials came from living things but are **no longer alive** — like a **dried leaf**, a **piece of wood**, or **cotton**.
- These are different from truly nonliving things like **stone** or **metal**, which were never alive.

## 🔍 Practice Sorting
- **Example 1:** A cat (living) vs. a stone (nonliving, never alive)
- **Example 2:** A piece of wood (once-living) vs. a rock (never alive)

Keep observing your surroundings — you're becoming a great sorter! 🌟

Makabansa.summary_markdown:
# 🏘️ Makabansa — Linggo 2: Ang Aking Komunidad

Alamin natin ang lokasyon at hitsura ng ating sariling komunidad! 🗺️

## 📍 Lokasyon ng Komunidad
- Alamin ang pangalan ng iyong **barangay**, **bayan/lungsod**, at **probinsiya**.
- Ang bawat komunidad ay may sariling **lokasyon** sa mapa.

## 🧭 Batayang Direksiyon
- **Hilaga** (North), **Timog** (South), **Silangan** (East), **Kanluran** (West)
- Ginagamit natin ang mga ito para makahanap ng lugar sa isang mapa.

## 🏔️ Heograpikong Tanawin
- Ang komunidad ay maaaring may **bundok, ilog, dagat, look, parke,** o **palayan**.
- Nakaaapekto ang mga tanawing ito sa **pamumuhay** ng mga residente — halimbawa, ang mangingisda ay nakatira malapit sa dagat.

Mahalagang kilalanin ang sarili nating komunidad! 🇵🇭

Computer.summary_markdown:
# 💻 Computer — Week 2: Parts of a Desktop Computer

Let's learn the main parts of a desktop computer! 🖥️

## 🖥️ Main Parts and Their Jobs
- **Monitor/Screen** — shows pictures and words so we can see what the computer is doing
- **CPU (System Unit)** — the **"brain"** of the computer that runs everything
- **Keyboard** — used for typing letters and numbers
- **Mouse** — used for pointing and clicking

## 🔍 Matching Parts to Jobs
- **Example 1:** To type your name, you use the **keyboard**.
- **Example 2:** To see your work on screen, you use the **monitor**.

Each part has an important job — together, they help the computer work! 🌟

GMRC.summary_markdown:
# 💖 GMRC — Linggo 2: Pagpapahalaga sa Sarili

Patuloy nating alamin at pahalagahan ang ating sarili! 🌟

## ⭐ Natatanging Katangian
- Bawat bata ay may sariling **hitsura**, **gusto**, at **kakayahan**.
- Walang dalawang batang eksaktong magkapareho — at ito ay maganda!

## 💪 Aking mga Lakas
- Tukuyin ang mga bagay na **magaling kang gawin** (halimbawa: pagguhit, pagkanta, paglalaro ng bola).
- Tanggapin din ang mga bagay na **kailangan mo pang matutunan** — ayos lang iyon!

## 💛 Pagpapahalaga sa Sarili Bilang Regalo
- Ang iyong buhay at katauhan ay isang **regalo**.
- Ipakita ang paggalang sa sarili sa pamamagitan ng pag-aalaga sa iyong katawan at damdamin.

Ikaw ay natatangi at napakahalaga! 🌟
